title: Personalize Experience Shows Default Content on Mobile Devices Due to Case-Sensitive Targeting Rule
alternate_search_terms: Personalize experience shows default content on mobile
targeting rule not matching mobile devices
device type Mobile vs mobile case sensitivity

extracted_facts.problem: The Personalize experience rendered correctly on desktop but always showed default content on mobile devices.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The experience's targeting rule used a device-type attribute value of "Mobile" (capitalized), while the SDK reported the device type in lowercase as "mobile", so the rule's comparison never matched on mobile devices.
resolution_steps: Update the targeting rule's device-type attribute value to lowercase "mobile" so it matches the value the SDK actually sends.
